descriptions.text: The Turkish cryptocurrency exchange BtcTurk has acknowledged that they suffered a hack. The exchange halted deposits and withdrawals while investigating, and said they are working with law enforcement. Furthermore, the exploiter sold substantial amounts of some cryptocurrencies, including Luna Classic, causing major price movements in those tokens.

On 22 June 2024, BtcTurk suffered a hot wallet key compromise across multiple networks, losing approximately $54 million. Most assets in cold storage remained secure. Some stolen funds were frozen by exchanges during recovery. Attackers accessed private keys associated with BtcTurk's hot wallets, enabling unauthorized withdrawals. Technical specifics about the initial compromise vector are unavailable, but evidence suggests direct control of wallet keys.

The Turkish cryptocurrency exchange BtcTurk has acknowledged that they suffered a hack that impacted ten hot wallets containing multiple cryptocurrencies. The exchange halted deposits and withdrawals while investigating, and said they are working with law enforcement. It appears that assets notionally worth around $55 million were stolen. Furthermore, the exploiter sold substantial amounts of some cryptocurrencies, including Luna Classic, causing major price movements in those tokens. According to newly installed Binance CEO Richard Teng, Binance froze $5.3 million of the stolen assets.
